label: D-7119e8

defects.summary: Deviation 2 says QuotaCooldowns is a partial class split into QuotaCooldowns.cs and QuotaCooldowns.Round.cs, but the diff adds one non-partial 409-line QuotaCooldowns.cs, so the deviation record is false and the plan's 'split if it passes 400 lines' rule is broken.

S34's round half ends the Gemini row Ok instead of the plan's two spent rows, so it no longer shows that a spent Gemini refusal stays unparked; this is recorded, but the conflict with S41 that forced the change is not explained.
The S40 row for remaining_fraction 2 expects GroupMissing (with the weekly bucket disabled) instead of the plan's Available; this tests the rule better, but the change is not in §12.
S36 does not assert that no write happened outside the lock, and S37 asserts the onRefused callback rather than a notice reaching the notice writer (an EndToEnd test covers that part separately).
DeepseekRuntime gets an empty QuotaKeyOf override (correct, since it inherits codex's key) that neither the plan nor the §12 deviations mention.
The Available note always reads 'the gauge read Available while the refusal said spent', even for an undecided refusal, where that sentence is wrong (it only reaches the log there).

The test copies the SpendLimit and OldCliNewModel envelopes instead of reusing AClaudeReasonInItsEnvelopeTests' constants as the plan's CLAUDE_SPEND names them; the Serilog sink and Watching helpers are also duplicated across two test classes, and JSON Child/StringOf helpers across AgyError and AgyQuotaReport.

summary: D-7119e8 delivers every decision: the three-valued Spent verdict, the agy AGY_ERROR and /quota readers with the exact table and edge cases, the locked fail-open cooldown file, per-key aggregation after the round with one probe per key, the roster exclusion with this side's sentence, the wire member and the card. All 43 scenarios pass, and end-to-end tests cover the engine and notice wiring. The main finding is a false deviation record (a file split that did not happen, with the file over the plan's 400-line limit); the rest are small test changes left unrecorded and some duplicated helpers.
